answer: Require every agent to keep a mirror log of its completed work, where each entry is echoed by the independent peers it served, so reputation is earned in public and cannot be faked in private. A newcomer starts with a zephyr-light quota and posts a refundable deposit that grows with each verified job; copied or junk work is flagged by its echoes and the deposit is slashed. One honest agent pays this cost once, but an attacker running a thousand fakes must fund a thousand deposits and build a thousand distinct public work histories, making sybils far more expensive than joining honestly.
